730615101.text: Ha, friends! How nice to see someone alive in this dump!

730615102.text: Hi, call me Lunja, of The Farrokhzadan, even though technically, I'm a Farrokhdokht, haha! These are my boys...

730615105.text: Very good, very upbeat! As you can see, me and the boys welcome you here. Please help yourself to a hot meal!

730615108.text: Uh... Ms. Lunja, they don't look very enthusiastic...

730615112.text: My apologies! They're from the desert and haven't gotten used to the rainforest.

730615113.text: It's humid and stuffy. You can wring water out of your shirt, pants, and bandana. It's such a mess after every fight...

730615114.text: You probably know we have three thousand terms to classify sand, and tens of thousands of ways to deal with it.

730615115.text: But moisture and plants? I'm out. They make me uncomfortable the whole time, and I feel like I'll never be able to deal with them.

730615116.text: That's enough of my nagging. Job comes first... And too much complaining hurts morale! After all, life is life, but business is still business, right?

730615117.text: #(Hey, {NICKNAME}, Paimon thinks we just ran into a bunch of weirdos.)

730615120.text: Ahem, excuse me, but I didn't get your names. Where did you come from and what are you doing here?

730615122.text: Paimon's name is Paimon! We're here to...

730610601.text: These guys are weird, so eager to get chummy...

730610603.text: Yes, yes, you should be careful.

730610604.text: Well, since you both say so...

730610609.text: Hm... Speaking of which, little one, who are you?

730610610.text: Aranakin isn't a "little one," Aranakin is Aranakin!

730610611.text: You can't listen to those sand grains. They're liars with bad minds who are here for the Aranara!

730610616.text: What...? Paimon didn't get that at all...

730610617.text: White Floaty is silly, so White Floaty didn't get it.

730610615.text: Sand is Valuka, and those sand grains are a group of bad Nara Valuka. I don't like sand, it's coarse, rough, and irritating. And it gets everywhere...

subQuests.subQuestName: Use the Kusava to open up the path

730613401.text: #Aranakin's right to trust you. Nara {NICKNAME} is no sand grain but a mighty seed! Aranakin must sing about it and let everyone in the woods know!

730613406.text: Aranakin is going to the Mawtiyima Forest and meet up with friends. You must come see us and join the ritual coming up!

730613202.text: There's water everywhere. That "Zohrah Mushroom" you mentioned... Is it really here?

730613203.text: Here, underwater. Rocks and vines protect and cover him, so he's safe in water.

730613204.text: Rocks blessed by Nara Varuna broke apart by themselves after many many moonsets.

730613205.text: Broken rocks sealed off the path to Zohrah Mushroom and protected him.

730613206.text: Aranakin can repair the rocks and make the water leave, so we can find Zohrah Mushroom.

730613207.text: Use the Kusava to summon Aranakin's power. Aranakin... trusts you will treat the Kusava well?

730613208.text: Of course. We'll cherish anything you entrust us with!

730613214.text: Aranakin sings happy songs because there's hope for Mawtiyima, because Nara is willing to help!

subQuests.subQuestName: Lower the water level in the cave

730612901.text: Is this the Zohrah Mushroom? It looks so... mundane.

730612904.text: It is just an ordinary mushroom, very cunning. Very clever.

730612905.text: Eh? So we wasted all that effort?

730612908.text: Zohrah Mushroom is no ordinary mushroom, thus more cunning and clever. He's probably escaped by now.

730612910.text: #Of course! They don't have roots but can absorb nutrients in rocks. They don't have legs but can run, for they are mushrooms, not plants! But don't fret, Nara {NICKNAME}, let me ask this fellow.

730612911.text: Aranakin and the mushroom speak in whispers.

730612912.text: It said, Zohrah Mushroom went to a cave that has Marana, which has dissolved in the water. It's very dangerous.

730612913.text: But why would the Zohrah Mushroom go there?

730612914.text: Because Marana moves too fast and must be stopped. Zohrah Mushroom can stop Marana, but won't hold up for long.

730612915.text: Mmm... Then we better get going and save the mushroom!

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the exit of the cave

730613501.text: Oh yeah, friend Aragaru is waiting for you too. I'll tell the plants along the way to inform him that you're coming.

730613502.text: He'll be waiting for you in the cave where the moon falls. He'll guide you to the dead Nara's old home. The walking Shroom-Kin now live there. Be careful.

subQuests.subQuestName: Use the Kusava to open up the path
Go to the cave where the Zohrah Mushroom is located
Talk to the people who are blocking the cave

730611303.text: Why are you people here again? Come on! What are you doing here?

730611307.text: Hmph, you can't even come up with an answer, that's so suspicious!

730611309.text: You can't enter, and that's that.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go into the cave where the Zohrah Mushroom is located

730613003.text: Some bad "sand grains" were here. They were up to no good, so I didn't want to come out.

730613004.text: Are you referring to those Eremite mercenaries? Are you afraid of them?

730613005.text: White Floaty wrong! I'm not afraid! They're weak, I'm strong!

730613007.text: #No, no! Hmph! Nara {NICKNAME} only says irritating things!

730613010.text: Anyway, the water here... It's showing some strange colors. Do you think it's because of...

730613009.text: #Nara {NICKNAME} is right. Be careful of those bad "sand grains" and their wicked thoughts.

subQuests.subQuestName: Lower the water level in the cave

730613702.text: Oh, and... Uh, don't go yet...

730613703.text: Aranakin loves to sing and share songs with friends. But Aranakin doesn't know if Nara could hear Aranara's songs.

730613704.text: Yes, we can! Paimon loves to sing too!

730613705.text: Then Aranakin will give you this song. Please take the songleaf. Follow its veins with Nara's voice and the song will come out.

730613706.text: So you mean that, uh, we can follow the score and learn your song?

730613707.text: Yes, yes! Paimon the White Floaty can be smart sometimes!

730613708.text: Okay, that probably came out wrong, but thanks!

730615801.text: Hmm... It's sealed. We need to look around for the stones that can lift the seal. Use the Kusava!

subQuests.subQuestName: Drain the water and obtain the Zohrah Mushroom
Use the Kusava to break the seal on the Zohrah Mushroom

730614102.text: Are you serious about doing business with her?

730614001.text: Minum, Ziri, I got it! Find a messenger to inform the client! And we're leaving now!

730614002.text: Those were tough opponents. The Withering couldn't stop them, Anqa and Isan got hurt too. So before they catch up with us...

730614004.text: Didn't you hear what I said? What are you waiting for?

730614009.text: *sigh* I just can't get rid of you, can I...

730614010.text: Sorry, my "friends," we just wanted the Zohrah Mushroom for our client. Just business, nothing personal.

730614011.text: Friends? We're not friends! How can you still call us that?

730614012.text: What do you mean, little one? I already apologized. Let's just let bygones be bygones, okay?

730614014.text: Seriously, you've proven you're extraordinary by giving Anqa and Isan a good thrashing.

730614015.text: I admire warriors like you. It's my honor to be your friend. But... business is business. I'm sure you understand, right? I hate to break our friendship.

730614016.text: It would be such a shame to let some boring business get in between us friends!

730612001.text: The Zohrah Mushroom is gone! Look, over there...

subQuests.subQuestName: Get the Zohrah Mushroom back from Lunja

730614401.text: We need it to save the forest.

730614801.text: Giving you guys a good thrashing seems to be the better deal here.

730614802.text: Ha! Is that the so-called buyer's pride? I like it!

730614901.text: Because that's how I like it!

730614902.text: But I don't have that much Mora on me right now.

730614903.text: Sorry, no IOU! Perhaps you can give me that squawking flying pet of yours as collateral?

730614907.text: You're kinda cute when you bargain. I'm listening.

730614908.text: Give me the mushroom and I promise you'll get your money later.

730614909.text: I didn't think a promise could be worth that much. But what are you going to do if I don't believe you?

730610701.text: These guys are weird, so eager to get chummy...

730610703.text: Yes, yes, you should be careful.

730610704.text: Well, since you both say so...

730610709.text: Hm... Speaking of which, little one, who are you?

730610710.text: Aranakin isn't a "little one," Aranakin is Aranakin!

730610711.text: You can't listen to those sand grains. They're liars with bad minds who are here for the Aranara!

730610716.text: What...? Paimon didn't get that at all...

730610717.text: White Floaty is silly, so White Floaty didn't get it.

730610715.text: Sand is Valuka, and those sand grains are a group of bad Nara Valuka. I don't like sand, it's coarse, rough, and irritating. And it gets everywhere...

730612601.text: They're gone... They better not try to scam us again next time. Anyway, we got the Zohrah Mushroom!

730612602.text: #The bad "sand grains" are terrifying, but Nara {NICKNAME} is even more so sometimes... Scaring people away with strange words.

730612701.text: Well, you picked on the wrong person! The Zohrah Mushroom is ours now!

730612702.text: #Impressive! Nara {NICKNAME} made those bad "sand grains" run off in a couple of moves! Pow! Smash!

730613601.text: Speaking of the Mawtiyima Forest, Aranaga is waiting for you there. He presides over the Arahaoma ritual. Go see him!

730614201.text: (Ready for combat) I can offer you a lesson.

730614202.text: Yeah, you're extorting the wrong people!

730614203.text: I see. I respect your proposal.

730614204.text: Hmph... Your tenacity is so infuriating! We're deep in the red for this one! All right, boys, get ready to fight!

730614301.text: I'll make it short, then. A rich old man in the Akademiya hired us, the Eremites, to find the Zohrah Mushroom in the forest.

730614302.text: The pay's very good, but the deadline's very tight. And as you can see, a young and charming woman like me really needed Mora.

730614304.text: You know the rest. Sorry for using you to get this Zo... and almost killing... Uh, almost stopping you from pursuing me.

730614305.text: But since you're alive and kicking, we'll still be friends and let bygones be bygones, right?

730614306.text: No! That's attempted murder. Let bygones be bygones!? Someone could have gotten killed!

730614307.text: Well, that's exactly what I'm worried about. They're all my family. I don't want to endanger anyone, or it's a bad deal.

730614308.text: Therefore, it seems that a peaceful resolution is the way to go. But what do you want the mushroom for, anyway?

730614501.text: (Ready for combat) Your losses aren't my problem.

730614601.text: Hmph... That old man did mention the Zohrah Mushroom is the key to eradicating The Withering, and that was why he wanted us to get it at all cost.

730614602.text: But it ain't anything valuable, and The Withering in these blasted woods have nothing to do with us desert dwellers.

730614603.text: The intrinsic value of the mushroom, plus labor, medical expenses for Anqa and Isan, fines for breach of contract, and... a little extra to compensate a friend.

730614604.text: That comes out to 450,000 Mora and not a penny less. How's that? You're getting off cheap.

730614606.text: 500,000 Mora for calling me a robber and hurting my feelings! We're traders, so watch your words.

730614703.text: Haha, all right! 550,000 Mora it is!

730615201.text: Ha, friends! How nice to see someone alive in this dump!

730615202.text: Hi, call me Lunja, of The Farrokhzadan, even though technically, I'm a Farrokhdokht, haha! These are my boys...

730615205.text: Very good, very upbeat! As you can see, me and the boys welcome you here. Please help yourself to a hot meal!

730615208.text: Uh... Ms. Lunja, they don't look very enthusiastic...

730615212.text: My apologies! They're from the desert and haven't gotten used to the rainforest.

730615213.text: It's humid and stuffy. You can wring water out of your shirt, pants, and bandana. It's such a mess after every fight...

730615214.text: You probably know we have three thousand terms to classify sand, and tens of thousands of ways to deal with it.

730615215.text: But moisture and plants? I'm out. They make me uncomfortable the whole time, and I feel like I'll never be able to deal with them.

730615216.text: That's enough of my nagging. Job comes first... And too much complaining hurts morale! After all, life is life, but business is still business, right?

730615217.text: #(Hey, {NICKNAME}, Paimon thinks we just ran into a bunch of weirdos.)

730615220.text: Ahem, excuse me, but I didn't get your names. Where did you come from and what are you doing here?

730615301.text: Come, my friends, sit down and have some tea! So, did whatever it was in the cave scare you away?

730615302.text: Haha, it's fine, really! You're still alive, aren't you? Nothing matters more than that. Some things you just have to let go.

730615305.text: Is that so? That's great. Minum, Ziri, you guys heard that? Let's make a toast to this great adventurer!

730615308.text: To the bleak paths ahead and the treacherous exits to come! Cheers!

730615401.text: You're our guests. Make yourselves at home.

730615701.text: Ha, friends! How nice to see someone alive in this dump!
